rationale: Frontier saturated after 10 explored rounds; expected value of every remaining single-mutation lever is negative. Latency best-so-far 30760ms with R2 (29839) and R4 (29740) both landing ~1000ms short of the 28760ms epsilon-win bar — strongly consistent with an input-side TTFT floor on ~20-page FINRA PDFs rather than output tokens, so further output trimming (citations beyond R1, hierarchy pruning, exclusions expansion) hits diminishing returns well before clearing the gate while taking real quality-floor risk (R10 just demonstrated: citation-count cap regressed -0.030 straight into the 0.9137 quality floor). Quality best-so-far 0.9437 with R4 (0.9704) only +0.0034 short of the 0.9737 bar — inside eval noise (~±0.02 on 20-row aggregate) — but no_repeat_failed_mutations blocks R4-equivalent re-proposals, and R5 proved that layering additional structural directives on top of R4 catastrophically collapses summary_quality (0.9406 → 0.8406) and even output_json_valid (1.0 → 0.95). All plausible net-new section_summary edits (R3/R5/R8/R9) landed in [-0.048, +0.002]; the only kept mutation ever (R1) is already in the current scaffold. identity.md was touched by R2 (compact-JSON) and reverted; output_schema.md is flagged fragile (legacy R9 edit: -0.047); exclusions.md deletion re-admits amendment-history padding; sampling perturbations (temp=0.1→0.0, top_p) are noise gambling per R6/R7 dismissal; max_tool_calls=0 is already minimal; new skills/rules carry R5-pattern clash risk. Across the lever space, P(gate-clear) × upside < P(regress > 0.03) × downside into the quality floor. Noop preserves the on-frontier R1-kept state (latency 30760, quality 0.9437) rather than burning the round on a mutation with negative expected value. R6, R7, R11 reached the same diagnosis from the same frontier; R10's revert since R11 reinforces rather than invalidates the saturation call.
